quarterly_data.signal: NetApp's Q4 fiscal 2026 release supplemental tables ($ in millions): Hybrid Cloud segment net revenues were $1,766 in Q4 FY26 versus $1,568 in Q4 FY25 (+13%) and $6,237 in FY2026 versus $5,907 (+6%); within the Hybrid Cloud segment, all-flash revenues were $1,216 in Q4 FY26 versus $1,034 in Q4 FY25, and hybrid-flash and other revenues $550 versus $534.
